title: grove arrow of the repo actor carries no host home path in git
description:
## .wish

the repo actor's `settings.of.grove.json` arrow stops to carry a host-specific home path in git.

## .why

`.agent/.actors/actor.via.repo=ambient/brain/.claude/settings.of.grove.json` is a symlink to
`~/.claude/settings.json`, written with the absolute home of whoever last ran `rhx init` or
`rhx upgrade` (e.g. `/home/camper/...` vs `/home/vlad/...`). each box that runs init flips the
tracked target, so every upgrade diff carries a box-local change that must be held out by hand.
the same holds for the `claudeMdExcludes` home path in `settings.of.repo.json`.

## .the outcome, one of

- the grove arrow is untracked by git (gitignored, findserted by init on each box), or
- its target is `~`-relative or otherwise box-neutral, so the tracked bytes are the same on every box

and a clean `rhx init` on a second box leaves `git status` clean.

## .see

- ehmpathy/rhachet pr 699, the upgrade commit held the arrow out by hand

---

dispatched by human + beaver 🦫
